title: add <url> saves a bookmark
statement: The CLI shall save a new bookmark with the given URL via `mark add <url>`.

title: list prints all bookmarks
statement: The CLI shall print every stored bookmark with its id via `mark list`.

title: open <id> launches a bookmark
statement: The CLI shall open the bookmark with the given id in the default browser via `mark open <id>`.

title: rm <id> deletes a bookmark
statement: The CLI shall delete the bookmark with the given id via `mark rm <id>`.

title: Bookmarks persist across runs
statement: Bookmarks persist to a local JSON file in the user's home directory.
